fields.label: Health IDs
fields.description: Every member covered on a policy gets a health ID when the policy is saved. Renewals (new policies) get new IDs. Leave empty to not generate health IDs.

fields.label: Policyholder health ID format
fields.description: For the member whose relationship is Self. Naming series: # = one digit, "." separates parts. E.g. PI.###### gives PI000001, PI000002…

fields.label: Member health ID format
fields.description: For every other member. E.g. HI.###### gives HI000001, HI000002…
